prompts.name: ToadLocomotion
prompts.prompt: Production 2D game sprite atlas, genuinely TRANSPARENT background with ZERO background glow, shadows, gradients, grids or labels. Image 1 is the APPROVED orange soda toad identity and medium-resolution pixel art style. Image 2 is old green atlas used ONLY for exact frame count, layout, motion and pose reference. Replace old green character with approved orange character in EVERY frame. Preserve orange body, cream belly, stern amber eyes, round translucent orange cheek reservoirs and carbonation bubbles clustered on back. Crisp stepped pixel outlines and pixel highlights, NOT smooth painterly style. All poses face three-quarter RIGHT. Keep same head, torso dimensions and feet baseline across frames except natural squash and stretch. Same framing and padding in each equal-size grid cell, all sprites wholly inside their own cells. Do not add detached floating bubbles outside body silhouette. No stream attached to character mouth (separate runtime VFX). 4 columns by 4 rows, EXACTLY 16 full-body frames. Rows 1 and 2: seamless 8-frame four-legged walking cycle, subtle torso and head bob. Rows 3 and 4: 8-frame idle breathing and blinking loop. All frames same body size. Retain full character design of image 1.
